main.description: One bibliographic reference in a user's library. Describes SOMEONE'S work (possibly the account holder's, possibly not) and makes no claim of authorship -- authorship claims live in id.career.authorship, so this lexicon stays useful to people who only manage citations. Duplicates across accounts are expected and correct: each user owns their copy. An AppView clusters copies into works by normalised DOI.

type.description: CSL item type. Determines which fields are meaningful and which BibTeX entry type is emitted. Kept strictly to the CSL vocabulary: Japanese output categories such as 予稿集, 紀要, and 解説 are NOT added here, because they describe where an item sits in a CV rather than what kind of thing it is. That routing lives in id.career.authorship (outputCategory and venueType), which keeps this lexicon usable by anyone rendering a citation.

citeKey.description: Stable citation key, e.g. 'yamada2024diffusion'. Stored, not derived: a regenerated key silently breaks every \cite{} in every manuscript that used it. Treat as immutable once set. Unique per account by convention, not by protocol.

originalTitle.description: Title in the original language when `title` holds a translation. Common for Japanese-language work cited in an English CV.

contributors.description: All contributors in all roles, in order. maxLength is generous because particle physics and genomics papers routinely list over a thousand authors.

containerTitle.description: Journal name, proceedings title, or book title for a chapter.

containerTitleShort.description: Abbreviated journal name (ISO 4), e.g. 'J. Chem. Phys.'. Many venues require it and machine derivation from the full name is unreliable, so store both.

collectionTitle.description: Series title, e.g. 'Lecture Notes in Computer Science'.

volume.description: String, not integer: volumes like '12A' and '3-4' exist.

page.description: Page range as printed, e.g. '331--345' or 'e0158393'.

genre.description: Sub-type rendered verbatim: 'PhD thesis', 'Technical report', '修士論文'.

event.description: Conference name when different from containerTitle.

doi.description: Bare DOI, e.g. '10.1371/journal.pone.0158393'. No https://doi.org/ prefix. Lowercase for indexing.

openAccessUrl.description: Direct link to freely readable full text, when one exists and differs from `url`.

work.description: Optional AT-URI of a richer record for the same work elsewhere in the network, e.g. a pub.oxa.* scientific document. Lets the library point at first-class content instead of duplicating it.

note.description: Bibliographic note belonging in the citation itself (BibTeX `note`). Personal commentary goes in pub.paper.readingStatus.

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the work itself, e.g. 'ja', 'en'.

license.description: SPDX identifier or licence URL, where known.

labels.description: Self-labels. Relevant for references to retracted or contested work.
